quest.title: The Child of the Jungle
quest.description: The Child of the Jungle is a finicky, mystical entity of Agon that inhabits a temple on the island of Yssam. Capricious and playful, the Child is looking for friends to bring him toys. The child might be just as giving.

node.tag: ADD IMPOSSIBLE TASK FOR QUEST DESCRIPTION
node.instruction: Bring gifts to the Lady of the Lake
node.journal_entry: The Agonian's steamy breath floated in the cold, crisp air. Soft, thick snow flakes were fell lazily in the lake when the apparition of a noble, white-clad lady rose up from within the crystal-clear water. The lady told the Agonian that she wished to see how the world around her had changed. She asked for gifts, and promised rewards.

action.tag: A Start Client SFX at World Location Action

node.journal_entry: I am still unsure what kind of people eat this willingly, or if at all. All I know is I have more where that came from, and I want none of it. It's those Wildtribe again, isn't it? Here, have some $[Resource.G.r_gristle_q04_NameSingular] if you think it's of any value.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Hey that's $[Resource.B.r_black_powder_NameSingular]! It's what makes cannons go boom, right? That's fun! Have you seen all the flash and heard that thunder? Here is one from a ship that ran aground! Quick, fire one for laughs! But maybe you need a ship for a $[Resource.S.r_ship_cannon_item_NameSingular] to work.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: This looks like a shell or something, but it looks really brittle and old, this $[Resource.F.r_fossil_NameSingular]. I'm not sure it will last long - I've only seen $[Resource.W.r_wisp_NamePlural] and $[Resource.S.r_spirit_NamePlural] carry those around. Maybe they have some use for it but I find that hard to believe. Sometimes I've seen them ground them down and turn them into $[Resource.B.r_black_powder_NameSingular], just like this little pile here.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Is that a worm? The kind that wiggles and burrows in trees? That's gross. I hope you don't eat that. Some people eat that and drink this. Maybe it's healthy for them, I don't know. Maybe they need to wash down the taste. Here, have some of that stuff, it might come in handy. Please stop bringing me gross things. I can only kill that once, that's not fun.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Hmm, this looks bloody. What do you do with that? Dogs eat that raw, have you seen dogs eat raw $[Resource.M.r_meat_NameSingular]? I bet it's a lot better than eating a $[Resource.L.r_larva_NameSingular], isn't it? I can cook it for you, I remember how to make $[Resource.M.r_meat_stew_NameSingular]. At least I think I do. Can't taste it really, I'm afraid.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Inferior Rawhide is made from the scraps of animal hides and smaller animal skins that cannot be used directly in leatherworking. The Vargashi believe nothing should go to waste - knowing that every little piece could prove critical for their survival, they might be found carrying all sorts of pelts and cut skins.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: $[Resource.L.r_lichen_NameSingular]? That feels like moss a bit. Sometimes it grows on stone and rock, sometimes on creatures, like those funny-looking $[Resource.H.r_heielhim_NameSingular]. I've seen them grind those down and brew them and turn it all into these funny-smelling potions, like this $[Resource.P.r_potion_stamina_major_NameSingular].

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: This does look a bit lively, doesn't it? Ripples are all funny-looking, there's tiny spark of life all over it. I keep some to toy around with, but there's always more to be found. Here, take this $[Resource.A.r_anima_q03_NameSingular] and see for yourself.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Bigger, larger this $[Resource.A.r_anima_q02_NameSingular] than the little ones, no? Maybe if you add all of them together something wonderful could happen. Here's an even bigger one for you, a $[Resource.A.r_anima_q04_NameSingular]! Aren't they a mystery?

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Some $[Resource.A.r_anima_q03_NameSingular], eh? I wonder whether these Earth Elementals need those to stay alive. At times, I've found this kind of $[Resource.A.r_anima_q05_NameSingular] more than once around where the Elementals live.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: $[Resource.S.r_shadowtaint_q01_NameSingular]. I don't like that dark, shady stuff. It's not fun at all - many have brought me things like that in the past and it's not something to toy around with. It gives me the same bad feeling when those $[Resource.D.r_deathless_servant_NamePlural] and $[Resource.D.r_deathless_mage_NamePlural] are roaming around the island.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: This reeks of something bad, don't you feel it as well? It's the same feeling I get when those deathless creatures float around. They are creepy, and they're not funny. And this is so dark and shady - take that someplace far away please.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: More of those mana flakes? I like things that shine, that I can play with. I really don't like anything that has to do with those deathless creatures, so have some more of those. I really hope you're not eating those for breakfast. It's glowing with this really evil light.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Small, shiny, tiny $[Resource.M.r_mana_flakes_q02_NameSingular]. But I want to have nothing to do with them - the deathless ones use those as well. You should be very careful, it's not something to toy around with. Even I know it's not fun at all, getting hunted down by the deathless ones. So have some $[Resource.M.r_mana_flakes_q04_NameSingular], because I can't stand being near them that long.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: I heard there's this thing called snow, it falls down in flakes they say. So, if there are mana flakes, there must be something called mana. But I've only seen those flakes when those deathless things are out and abound. And these flakes don't fall out of the sky like snow does. Snow sounds fun, these flakes are glowing all right but I don't want anything to do with those deathless things, so you take those $[Resource.M.r_mana_flakes_q05_NamePlural] with you.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: This is sticky and creepy and everything not fun. Why do you keep going around those deathless things all the time? You think they're not fun? They're no fun at all, this is what one of them left behind one day! Creepy robes!

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: More of those fungi? I don't know why they call them that, but they're not fun. Have a bigger one if you think you know what to do with them.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: More of that? It looks like mushrooms but it's not quite that, is it? It looks like what grows under the wings of those big ugly bug-like creatures, the $[Resource.E.r_eodrin_NameSingular] they call them, right? I don't care about any of that, it's mushy and it's not funny. Here, have a bigger one - it looks as if there are loads of that lying around. I've heard people even grow them, worse yet eat them. That's not true, is it?

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: $[Resource.E.r_egg_NamePlural]! Isn't that what chickens lay? Where did you find that? I guess it was some of those pesky $[Resource.R.r_raven_standard_grunt_NamePlural] or $[Resource.R.r_raven_standard_officer_NamePlural]. Was it one of the $[Resource.R.r_raven_standard_veteran_NamePlural]? Nevermind, I don't like $[Resource.E.r_egg_NamePlural]! But I like $[Resource.C.r_crab_caserole_NameSingular]. Taste some!

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: This smells like blood, but it's not runny or gooey. It's like a dust. It's called $[Resource.R.r_rust_NameSingular], isn't it? It's what those Raven Standard weapons are covered mostly in. I've seen some wise folk use it in making little bottles of colored drinks that make you feel funny. Here's a red sack with some of those bottles inside, I don't want them. They make me feel pretty vacant.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: The Lady of the Lake thanked the Agonian for his gifts and his efforts with more than just the small trinkets she was able to make for him.

action.tag: An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: That's a piece of something alright. Smells kind of rotten to be honest. You must have got this off these dead creatures that still move around, right? Here's a bigger one - maybe if you put them all together you can build one of your own to play with. I have tried but it never works. The funny bits fall off every time.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: I don't understand what this thing is. It's like every other shape on stone and rock that I see from time to time. And on paper too, but I know it's different. There's something magical to it - but it's not fun. It just sits there - maybe if there was a game we could play with all these glyphs. Oh well, you try with this one - looks really old.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: $[Resource.F.r_fungus_q02_NamePlural].. That grows on $[Resource.J.r_junglestomper_NamePlural], isn't that right? I think that's about right. There's not much use for that, unless you can turn it into $[Resource.F.r_fungus_q05_NameSingular] first. But then again it smells funny and is kind of gross. I think I have a larger one that someone else brought me - I don't really want to keep it. Here, you take it.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: I've seen that black sticky goo before. It should be good to glue things together, this $[Resource.T.r_tar_material_NameSingular]. But all I've managed so far is this smelly ball of something. I light it up and throw it around at night - it's like little fireballs. Here's some! Go on, set something on fire with it!

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Oo, shiny! Look at how the light looks so funny through that piece of $[Resource.Q.r_quartz_NameSingular]. Nice colors! See what happens when you use this tube that brings everything closer!

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Wow, this looks so small and rare and precious! I wonder if it breaks when you try to.. Oops. Sorry about that. There must be more where that came from. It does look a bit like $[Resource.E.r_eodrin_NameSingular] skin. Here, I've found some clothes that look like this if you look real close - if it doesn't fit you that's okay.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: It ripples and vibrates, this $[Resource.A.r_anima_q04_NameSingular]. It's like it is almost alive, isn't it? I keep them as pets and like to toss them around from time to time. Here you go, try this one - has a nice fuzziness, does it not?

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: That's like a piece of stone or something, isn't it? It's not flint, I know because of the sparks and all that. Looks like what the balls are made of - or those big hulks, the golems. You think you could make a ball for us to play with? It's worth a try, doesn't it? Here, take a bigger one and try to put them together.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Eww, does anyone ever eat that? It looks like you ripped it off a poor little helpless animal. I guess it was probably one of those Wildtribe then. I have some of that in better shape - people keep bringing them while they're not really fun to play with and smell bad.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.instruction: Harvest and return gifts to the Lady of the Lake

node.journal_entry: Yuck, that's $[Resource.B.r_bile_q02_NameSingular]. Where did you get that from? Those Wildtribe again? They really are gross. Is that what they eat? Because it would make sense, but I really can't think how to play with bile. Because of those stupid Wildtribe there's people bringing me more all the time, so here you go - do what you want with it!

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Bile again? Only this time $[Resource.B.r_bile_q03_NameSingular]? It's greener, that's all. And I have this $[Resource.B.r_bile_q05_NameSingular] which is even worse!

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: That's a tiny magical mushroom, isn't it? It's kind of cute but there's not a lot of it to play around with, is there? Maybe you have a better idea of what to do with this $[Resource.F.r_fungus_q03_NameSingular]?

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: That's not a Wildtribe $[Resource.E.r_eye_q01_NameSingular]? Is it? Please tell me it isn't a Wildtribe $[Resource.E.r_eye_q01_NameSingular]. Because it means all these eyes, like this $[Resource.E.r_eye_q03_NameSingular], are from Wildtribe, right?

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: We could play a game of beads with all these $[Resource.E.r_eye_q02_NameSingular] but I find it kind of gross. Don't you think it's kind of gross? Maybe you have some more use for all these Wildtribe eyes, like this $[Resource.E.r_eye_q04_NameSingular].

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: That's a really big chunk from a dead Wildtribe's neck, isn't it? I really think you should have more of those, like this $[Resource.G.r_gristle_q05_NameSingular].

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: $[Resource.G.r_glyph_q02_NamePlural] can be funny looking but there's not much to play with. Can you think of a game with glyphs? Here's a $[Resource.G.r_glyph_q04_NameSingular] - maybe you can think of something better to do with those.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: That looks fuzzy, it's $[Resource.L.r_lye_NameSingular], isn't it? Maybe if we had this big ball of it we could play something, but this isn't much. It's what cloth is made of, isn't it? Like this piece of $[Resource.T.r_theyril_cloth_NameSingular] right here, isn't it? Should we make a flag out of it and built a castle to play in?

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Fungi? So this $[Resource.F.r_fungus_q05_NameSingular] is in fact a very big mushroom? That's not a lot of fun. And don't eat it, I've heard people can die eating those. But I think you can make useful things out of those really big mushrooms, like this $[Resource.R.r_robes_m_widowsilk_shoulders_NameSingular]. Here, try it on - see if it suits you. Maybe we can play hide and seek with you wearing that!

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: Hmm, grass? $[Resource.S.r_steedgrass_NameSingular]? The place is filled with grass and you bring me $[Resource.S.r_steedgrass_NameSingular]? Oh, it's what mounts are made of, isn't it? I suppose it won't hurt to ride on one for a while, just like the old times. Here's a $[Resource.F.r_figurine_eradan_NameSingular]. Let's go riding together!

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: More of this $[Resource.O.r_ooze_q02_NameSingular]? Maybe we can fill a pool of it but I'm not sure it'd be safe to swim in it. Could you please take this $[Resource.O.r_ooze_q04_NameSingular]? It's so icky I can't really find any use for it.

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: What kind of gooey thing is this $[Resource.O.r_ooze_q01_NameSingular]? It feels funny and all that but I'm not sure we can play around with ooze - all it does is drip. Maybe you can find something useful to do with it. I sure hope so, because there's a lot of it I could do without, like this $[Resource.O.r_ooze_q03_NameSingular].

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action

node.journal_entry: This $[Resource.M.r_marrow_q03_NameSingular], that's made from bones, isn't it? We could play around with a big bone, like a dinosaur bone, but there's not a lot you can find lying around. This though, it's all mushy and icky. Just like this $[Resource.M.r_marrow_q05_NameSingular].

action.tag: A Take Item(s) from Player's Inventory Action
An Add Item(s) to Player's Inventory Action
